title: SocialPost - Data API
description: Represents a snapshot of a post on a social network such as a Facebook or Twitter. This object is available in API version 23.0 and later.

AnalyzerScore.description: Score set on the social post in Social Studio.

AssignedTo.description: User in Social Studio that the social post is assigned to.

AttachmentType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
AttachmentType.description: Type of the first attachment on the social post. Values are: APPLICATION AUDIO IMAGE LINK TEXT UNKNOWN VIDEO

AttachmentUrl.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AttachmentUrl.description: URL for the first attachment on the social post.

Classification.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Classification.description: Classification for the social post, such as inquiry or customer case.

CommentCount.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CommentCount.description: Number of comments on the social post.

DeletedById.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DeletedById.description: If the social post is deleted, ID of the person who deleted the social post. This is a relationship field.

EngagementLevel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
EngagementLevel.description: Engagement level of the social post, such as reviewed or resolved.

ExternalPostId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalPostId.description: ID of the social post in its social network.

Handle.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Handle.description: Handle of the person who posted the social post.

HarvestDate.description: Date and time when Social Studio collected the social post.

Headline.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

HiddenById.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
HiddenById.description: If the social post is hidden, ID of the person who hid it. This is a relationship field.

InboundLinkCount.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
InboundLinkCount.description: Number of links on the inbound social post.

IsOutbound.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsOutbound.description: Specifies whether the social post is outbound or not.

KeywordGroupName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
KeywordGroupName.description: Radian6 field that is no longer used.

Language.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

LastReferencedDate.description: Date when the social post was last referenced.

LastViewedDate.description: Date when the social post was last viewed.

LikedBy.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LikedBy.description: ID of the managed social account in the social network that liked the social post.

LikesAndVotes.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LikesAndVotes.description: Radian6 number of likes and votes on the social post.

MediaProvider.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MediaProvider.description: Social network of the social post.

MediaType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MediaType.description: Type of social network of the social post.

MessageType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
MessageType.description: Type of message. Values are: Comment—Facebook comment Direct—Twitter direct message Post—Facebook post Private—Facebook private message Reply—Twitter or Facebook reply Retweet—Twitter retweet Tweet—Twitter tweet

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

Notes.description: Notes added by Social Hub actions for the social post.

OutboundSocialAccountId.description: ID of the social account used for outbound social posts. This is a relationship field.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the owner of the social post. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

ParentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ParentId.description: ID of the parent record of the social post, for example, the ID of a case. This is a relationship field.

PersonaId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PersonaId.description: ID of the social persona who made the post. This is a relationship field.

PostPriority.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PostPriority.description: Priority of the social post set in Social Studio.

PostTags.description: Comma-separated list of tags on the social post.

PostUrl.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Posted.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Sort, Update
Posted.description: Date and time when the social post was made.

Provider.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
Provider.description: Social network of the social post.

R6PostId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
R6PostId.description: Unique ID of the post in Social Studio.

R6SourceId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
R6SourceId.description: ID of the author in Social Studio.

R6TopicId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
R6TopicId.description: ID for either the topic profile or the managed account in Social Studio.

Recipient.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Recipient.description: ID of the recipient of the social post in Social Studio.

RecipientType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
RecipientType.description: Type of the recipient of the social post, such as a person.

ReplyToId.description: Dynamically generated from replyToExternalPostId in Social Studio. This is a relationship field.

ResponseContextExternalId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ResponseContextExternalId.description: External ID, such as a conversation ID, author ID, or post ID, for the item you’re responding to.

ReviewScale.description: Review scale for the social post.

ReviewScore.description: Review score for the social post.

ReviewedStatus.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ReviewedStatus.description: Status of the social post review.

Sentiment.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Sentiment.description: Sentiment of the social post. Values are: Negative Neutral Positive SomewhatNegative SomewhatPositive

Shares.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Shares.description: Number of times the social post has been shared.

SourceTags.description: Comma-separated list of author type tags.

SpamRating.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
SpamRating.description: Spam rating of the social post. Values are: NotSpam Spam

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: Status of the social post. Values are: DELETED FAILED HIDDEN PENDING PENDING_APPROVAL RECALL_APPROVAL REJECTED_APPROVAL REPLIED SENT UNKNOWN

StatusMessage.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
StatusMessage.description: Status message for the social post.

ThreadSize.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

TopicProfileName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TopicProfileName.description: Name of the topic profile for the social post in Social Studio.

TopicType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TopicType.description: Type of topic. Values are: Keyword Managed

TruncatedContent.description: Truncated content of the social post.

UniqueCommentors.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UniqueCommentors.description: Number of unique people who commented on the social post.

ViewCount.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ViewCount.description: Number of times the social post was viewed.

WhoId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
WhoId.description: Polymorphic ID of a person such as a lead or a contact. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

usage:
The fields on a SocialPost object don’t provide real-time data. They provide a snapshot of information from the last time Salesforce collected the post from the social network. Many of the Radian6-related fields are no longer accurate or used.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **SocialPostChangeEvent (API version 48.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **SocialPostFeed (API version 26.0)**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **SocialPostHistory (API version 26.0)**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **SocialPostOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **SocialPostShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
